title: Conceptualizing, Measuring, and Managing Customer-Based Brand Equity

verification.method: Web check of title/author/publisher/year against publisher or library records
verification.notes: Journal of Marketing, Vol. 57, No. 1 (January 1993), pp. 1-22. The JSTOR DOI 10.2307/1252054 resolves to the same article; the SAGE DOI is canonical.

summary: The peer-reviewed foundation of customer-based brand equity: brand knowledge modeled as brand awareness plus brand image, and equity defined as the differential effect of that knowledge on consumer response.
